verdict.rationale: Codex cloud explicitly supports running multiple tasks in parallel in isolated cloud environments and reviewing each result's summary/diff before merging or requesting follow-up, which enables comparing outcomes across runs. However, there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated 'multiple attempts of the same task' or side-by-side attempt-comparison feature (e.g., best-of-n selection UI) as distinct from simply running independent parallel tasks. Missing for 10: explicit same-task multi-attempt workflow, dedicated comparison UI/feature, and independent/hands-on confirmation that users actually run parallel attempts of one task to pick the best.
